about: Shared matcher cases. tests/test_matcher.py (Python) and site-tests/matcher.test.mjs (JavaScript) both run every case, so the package and the page demo agree. 'expect' lists [term label, matched text] pairs in reading order. Options default to case_sensitive=false, whole_word=true.

cases.name: lower-case keyword finds a capitalised word
cases.text: Mangrove nurseries open along the creek

cases.name: capitalised keyword finds lower-case text (the original bug)
cases.text: currents in the pemba channel were unusually warm

cases.name: capitalised keyword finds an all-capitals headline
cases.text: KILWA FISHERS AGREE NEW CLOSED SEASON

cases.name: case-sensitive mode keeps the capitals
cases.text: KILWA and kilwa do not count, Kilwa does

cases.name: short keyword is not found inside a longer English word
cases.text: Steel prices rise as wheel makers feel the pinch

cases.name: the same short keyword is found when it stands alone
cases.text: A moray eel, photographed at the reef edge

cases.name: substring mode shows the false positives
cases.text: Steel prices rise as wheel makers feel the pinch

cases.name: Swahili keyword is not found inside a longer Swahili word
Swahili keyword found as a word
cases.text: Kasa wa kijani warejea ufukweni baada ya miaka kumi

cases.name: punctuation counts as a word boundary
cases.text: "Reef," she said. (Mikoko!) reef-building corals; reef's edge

cases.name: keyword at the very start and very end of the text
digits and underscores are word characters
phrase matches across extra spaces and a line break
cases.text:
A new Marine   Protected
Area was gazetted

cases.name: phrase matches across a hyphen and a non-breaking space
phrase does not match when the words are run together or interrupted
cases.text: coralbleaching; coral, bleaching; coral and bleaching

cases.name: phrase edges respect word boundaries
cases.text: sea turtles nest here; a deepsea turtle; one sea turtle

cases.name: variants on one line report the same term
cases.text: Mikoko elfu tano yapandwa; mangroves return; mkoko mmoja

cases.name: Swahili phrase
cases.text: Serikali yatangaza Hifadhi ya Bahari mpya

cases.name: Swahili word with an apostrophe, typed straight, found curly
apostrophe word is not split into a false match
accented name, composed keyword against decomposed text
accented letters are word characters, not boundaries
case folding outside ASCII
regular-expression characters in a keyword are literal
overlapping terms are both reported, longest first
comments, blank lines and duplicates are ignored
hashtag and handle keywords
a word that is English in one language and grammar in the other still matches
empty watch-list finds nothing
empty text finds nothing
